stem: A river flows from East to West. Two boats start from the southern bank of the river simultaneously. The boat A rows towards $20{^\circ}$ east of north, whereas boat B rows towards $20{^\circ}$ west of north. Both boats have same speed in still water. Which of the two boats will reach the northern bank first? The width of river is uniform.

options.C: Both will reach at the same time
options.D: will depend on speed of river flow
